newsitem.title: USA: CME March lumber up $10 limit on short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME March lumber up $10 limit on short covering.

text.p: March CME lumber futures ran up for a limit gain of $10.00 per per thousand board foot on persistent short covering, traders said.
At 1140 CST, March was up limit at $413.60 tbf. Limitless January was up $7.60 at $408.10. Other months were up $4.80 to $3.90 per tbf.

Prices moved up from the start despite talk of continued weakness in cash lumber. Higher financials, bargain hunting and an oversold condition Monday provided early support which prompted the scattered short covering, traders said.
